text.tspan: Opening: "Every day, 120 hospital beds…" - unit pictogram
One icon = one hospital bed filled every day, 2011-2021 (bed days ÷ 4,018 days). Greyscale wireframe: dark = pedestrians, light = cyclists.
One icon = one hospital bed filled every day (average, 2011-2021)
Days in hospital from road-crash admissions ÷ 4,018 days. Source: (BITRE, 2023).
Icons fill in one by one the first
time the opening is on screen
